compiled:
📰 General

Reflecting Pool Repairs Face New Challenge: Peeling Blue Paint Emerges •

Crews working to restore the Reflecting Pool at the White House are encountering a new obstacle – significant peeling of the blue paint. This issue arose following a recently completed $14.2 million renovation project, overseen by former President Donald Trump. Workers have been addressing algae growth after the renovation, but now must tackle the extensive paint damage. The project was intended to provide a long-lasting restoration, with an estimated lifespan of 100 years.

🌍 World

Ismael Kone Injured in Canada’s Dominant Victory Over Qatar at World Cup •

Canada secured a resounding 6-0 victory over Qatar in the World Cup, but the match was marred by an injury to forward Ismael Kone. Kone sustained a concerning injury during a second-half tackle that resulted in a red card for Qatar’s Assim Madibo. Medical personnel attended to Kone immediately following the incident. The extent of Kone’s injury remains unclear, pending further evaluation.

🦅 US

Rare Tick-Borne Virus Leaves New Hampshire Man Hospitalized and Unable to Speak •

A 66-year-old man from New Hampshire is currently hospitalized in Boston following a tick bite. John Reagan developed a serious tick-borne virus, resulting in critical condition and subsequent neurological symptoms. Friends and family report he is now nonverbal as a result of the infection. Medical professionals are working to determine the specific virus involved and administer appropriate treatment. The case highlights the potential dangers of tick-borne illnesses.

💰 Business

Mercedes-Benz Unveils Electric MPV Offering Limo-Like Comfort and Space •

Mercedes-Benz has introduced the VLE 300, a new electric multi-purpose vehicle (MPV) designed to deliver limousine-level luxury and ample passenger space. The vehicle utilizes 800V battery technology and boasts seating for eight adults, offering significantly more rear legroom than a standard S-Class sedan. It features top-tier infotainment systems and is engineered for maximum passenger comfort. Mercedes anticipates this MPV will appeal to families and those seeking a premium electric vehicle experience.

💻 Technology

Android 17 Update Causes 5G Disconnections on Some Pixel Devices •

Recent updates to Android 17 are experiencing issues with 5G connectivity on several Pixel devices. Users are reporting a sudden loss of 5G signal following the software update, impacting models including the Pixel 9 Pro series. Google is investigating the root cause of the problem, which appears to be related to the new update’s implementation. Initial reports suggest the issue is widespread, with numerous users experiencing the same disruption. Google has acknowledged the problem and is working on a potential fix.

🎭 Entertainment

Sugar Season 2 Review: Colin Farrell’s Dark Mystery Continues to Impress •

Season 2 of Apple TV+'s Sugar continues the story of private investigator Jack Kelly, played by Colin Farrell, as he investigates a complex and unsettling case. The season expands upon the mythology established in the first, revealing more about the enigmatic “The Voice” and its influence on Kelly’s life. Critics praise Farrell’s performance and the show’s atmospheric tone, describing it as a compelling blend of noir and supernatural elements. The season delves deeper into the show’s central mysteries, offering a darker and more intricate narrative than its predecessor.

🏅 Sports

Florida State Adds Third Official Visitor: Linebacker CJ Ohuabunwa Arrives •

Florida State Seminoles are welcoming a third official visitor to campus this weekend. Three-star linebacker CJ Ohuabunwa, hailing from Greater Atlanta Christian School in Norcross, Georgia, is currently en route to Tallahassee. The prospect’s visit marks the third official visit for the program this recruiting cycle. Ohuabunwa’s arrival adds to the growing interest in the Seminoles’ linebacker position.

🔬 Science

Physicist Creates Miniature Universe in Lab to Test Fundamental Concepts of Time •

A physicist has successfully created a miniature, self-contained universe within a laboratory setting to investigate the nature of time. The experiment utilized a system of superconducting circuits and lasers, mimicking conditions thought to exist in the very early universe. Researchers observed behavior consistent with quantum mechanics, demonstrating that time, as traditionally understood, may not be a fundamental constant at the smallest scales. This controlled environment offers a unique opportunity to probe the relationship between space, time, and quantum phenomena.

🩺 Health

Trump Administration Moves to Relax Testosterone Therapy Prescription Rules •

The Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) has requested revisions to the prescribing information for testosterone replacement therapy drugs. The proposed changes would loosen restrictions currently in place, potentially making it easier for older men to obtain the treatment. The HHS argues the current regulations are overly burdensome and limit access to a medically prescribed therapy. The revisions would allow for broader use of testosterone replacement therapy, focusing on individual patient needs and physician discretion.
